watchme.trigger: On any build_inspector sweep: fires when the reorg residue is non-empty beyond the hand-named dissolutions — i.e. when some address a berthed packet charted resolves neither in the world, nor through git's transitive rename record, nor through a directory plurality, nor through a hand-authored forwarding order. watchme.enough: ASYMMETRIC, and the asymmetry is the ticket's falsifier. ONE derived forward whose target does not exist, or one address the derivation claims to have resolved that a later sieve still reds, is STRONG FALSIFICATION and satisfies alone — a tolerance that launders a broken address is worse than the red it replaced, because a red is distrusted by construction and a green tolerance is leaned on. CONFIRMATION is weak and needs THREE non-vacuous sweeps at zero-residue-beyond-the-hand-named, AT LEAST ONE OF THEM TAKEN AFTER A BULK MOVE — because a derivation that has never seen the corpus move is the misaimed census this system has already met once, and the whole claim is that it keeps up. A vacuous reading (zero rename records read) counts toward neither.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier, carrying the two numbers gate (4) demands — addresses resolved by derivation, and the residue with each member named — so the residue is a list a hand can answer rather than a count a reader can round down.
watchme.consumer: build_inspector, which owns the sieves the tolerance feeds and is the component that re-opens this node when the intention stops working (Law 6 — the probe deposits and pokes, and carries no authority).
